mappings.rationale: Both directional BPS Vol.2 lampiran tables (forward Lampiran 5 p.170 and reverse Lampiran 10 p.363) show a single-row 36003<->36003 correspondence with no other 2020 or 2025 code touching it on either side, confirming a clean 1:1, not a disguised split/merge. Title changed from 'Aktivitas Penunjang Treatment Air' (2020) to 'Aktivitas Penunjang Penyediaan Air' (2025), but the 2025 uraian text describes the identical underlying scope: activities directly connected with the provision of water -- leasing/lending of water distribution networks, billing, and other support activities -- plus individual water distribution (pikulan/dorongan/tangki peddlers), explicitly excluding third-party meter-reading (routed to 8299). This is a support-service code adjacent to but distinct from the core water-production codes 36001/36002, and the 2025 uraian's scope matches the semantic footprint of the 2020 title ('Treatment Air' support work), not merely a similar-sounding title.
